note_tweet.text:
Nikita, if we look at the reality of X’s subscription model with approximately 5 million active paid subscribers the financial picture is clear:

Premium (3M subscribers at $8/mo): $24M/month ($288M/year).

Premium+ (1M subscribers at $16/mo): $16M/month ($192M/year).

Basic (1M subscribers at $3/mo): $3M/month ($36M/year).

Total Annual Revenue from individuals alone: ~$516 million.

This is in addition to the massive revenue from Enterprise/Verified Organizations and API access, which bridges the gap to the annual billion-dollar subscription mark, plus the $2.3 billion earned from advertisements in 2026. Nikita, we are the ones fueling this revenue—the content creators, the ones who post, quote, and drive engagement. Yet, you are reducing our reach, cutting our earnings, and burying our replies at the bottom or in the 'Spam' folder.

Where is all this money going, Nikita? Are you trying to keep it all for yourself? Do you have any sense, or are you just trying to mock the major content creators who have millions of followers—the very people who keep this platform alive? We, the subscribers, are funding you, yet you marginalize us. If this continues, there is no reason for us to subscribe or pour our money into your platform.

Will you reconsider your policies, or should we cancel our subscriptions? We are injecting millions of dollars into your platform, and you respond by silencing content creators and suppressing the reach of our interactions. Why do you want to prevent the exchange of ideas?

I urge everyone to share this post so it reaches all Premium and Premium Plus subscribers. They need to know the truth about the money we provide, which Nikita and X are using while simultaneously marginalizing those who make the platform successful. To all followers and fellow subscribers, please share this with everyone you know so they realize the reality of the funds we provide and how we are being treated.
